openrouter-api.$comment: All requests to the OpenRouter API.

openrouter-read.$comment: Read anything from the OpenRouter API: list models and providers, and read key, credit, and generation metadata.

openrouter-write.$comment: Create, update, or delete through the OpenRouter API: manage API keys, workspaces, guardrails, files, and account settings. Also covers running inference.

openrouter-inference.$comment: Run models through the OpenRouter inference endpoints (POST chat/completions, messages, responses, embeddings, rerank, images, videos, and audio speech/transcriptions), which consume credits. Verified against the OpenRouter OpenAPI spec.
